findings.title: Cross-tenant employee profile photos readable by any authenticated user via Explorer file.php path parameter.
findings.attacker: Any authenticated employee session (including low-privilege users in a different tenant).
findings.attack_path: Sign in as company-2 user, request modules/explorer/file.php?path=Private/Admin_1/profile/Admin_1.png. file.php classifies the path as a profile photo, skips Private-folder ACL checks, resolves storage to the victim home company_id, and readfile() serves the bytes without verifying tenant access.
findings.impact: Cross-tenant read of employee profile images stored under Private/ trees; enables harvesting PII-bearing photos across companies when usernames and employee IDs are known or enumerable.
findings.evidence: Validated by seeding Admin_1 profile PNG under files/1/Private/Admin_1/profile/ and confirming company-2 session logic resolves and reads the file while skipping private ACL and vault gates.
